findings.statement: The deployed Cart control function allows the static origin and routes owner commands through the existing serialized bridge/reconcile path.
Guest Mode defaults closed when absent and is committed as metadata with an empty actuator target set; guest command actions are mapped into the existing reducer and revision-fenced bridge.

findings.statement: Direct browser-to-existing-function calls are the smallest compatible architecture because the exact static host is already CORS-allowed and the current backend owns command serialization.

native_capability_check.capability: Existing Cloudflare static host, deployed Supabase Cart control function, canonical reducer, bridge, and reconcile function.
source_refs: Current owner-authorized Guest V1 integration correction
native_capability_check.rationale: The verified platform surface provides the static page, existing CORS, owner authorization, canonical state, serialized commit, and reconciliation; no alternate identity or session subsystem is needed.

mature_external_component_check.rationale: No new component or dependency is required; existing platform services already satisfy the requirements.
mature_external_component_check.not_relevant_reason: This is minimal glue to the deployed native Cart path.

decision_rationale.selected_path: Direct static Guest page to existing hbnf-cart-control; owner-only GUEST_MODE uses existing paired-device/operator authorization; guest action mapping uses same reducer, bridge, and reconcile.
alternatives_considered: Supabase anonymous Auth and RLS expansion
decision_rationale.challenger_analysis: Separate sessions, identities, tokens, and device endpoints duplicate machinery and weaken reuse of the current serialized state boundary. Existing CORS and deployed routes meet this case. Metadata changes reconcile with no hardware targets; commit races are rejected at expectedRevision compare-and-commit.
decision_rationale.tradeoffs: Trusted-friend V1 uses the publicly reachable function with no separate guest identity, as explicitly approved. Guest action surface remains narrow. No live service or device was mutated.
decision_rationale.simplest_robust_solution: Use existing static hosting and the existing revision-fenced Cart command path with a closed action mapping.
decision_rationale.critical_path_reason: Coordinator identified the exact host and deployed interfaces, resolving the previous integration blocker without live mutation.
